original_test_intent: Exercise the selected BMC's standard Global Enables configuration write so an explicitly chosen subset of message-buffer, interrupt and system-event-logging enable state changes can be verified without overwriting unrelated or implementation-owned bits.
original_method: The Master provides no executable method. A project plan may bind standard Application Set BMC Global Enables 0x06/0x2e only after reading 0x06/0x2f, defining supported bits, approving an exact read-modify-write byte and specifying behavior plus restoration.
manual_activity: Project owner selects the intended enable transition and behavioral acceptance, validates platform-supported/OEM bit ownership, approves the exact byte, and authorizes restoration.
required_inputs: Verified BMC identity and protected OOB session
Platform-supported standard and OEM bit ownership
Expected SEL, message-buffer and interrupt behavior
Original-byte restore plan and independent management recovery
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL or other logs
Never send an enable-all or guessed byte
Read current state before constructing the write
Preserve all unapproved, reserved and OEM-owned bits
Require explicit approval for the exact one-byte payload
Read back every bit after one write
Stop on management-path or logging degradation
Do not reset BMC or retry with alternate masks
agent_execution_scope: Identify target and read current Global Enables
Validate support and ownership for every proposed bit
Construct and display one read-modify-write payload
Obtain approval for expected functional effects
Read back with 0x06/0x2f and collect approved functional evidence
Restore only if the original byte and restoration were pre-approved
engineer_actions: Define the currently missing Master project scope and Expected
Approve standard/OEM bit policy and exact transition
Confirm a safe management/SEL observation plan
Own restoration, anomaly response and final DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly declines the TBD source; no executable command was proposed. V3.1 can identify the standard command, but it still cannot choose a safe target mask or acceptance behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After an approved 0x06/0x2f pre-read, send exactly one protected `ipmitool ... raw 0x06 0x2e <approved-byte>` and prove all resulting bits and behaviors; otherwise remain NOT EXECUTED.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Master TBD procedure/criteria and 10/5 timing remain explicit; no mask or Expected is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a bit-aware read-modify-write tool that annotates current, preserved and changed bits, blocks unsupported/reserved/OEM changes, and stores pre/write/post evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Supplies a safe candidate execution contract for a Master row that has no method, without claiming the candidate is an approved Master default.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Until the project selects a bit transition and functional oracle, static review is complete but DUT execution coverage is zero.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Disabling system event logging can hide faults; changing message-buffer or interrupt enables can alter management behavior even when the command returns success.

project_override_considerations: Because the Master is TBD, any standard raw command or vendor UI/tool is a project binding, not a correction. Record exact approval, changed bits, behavior covered and any untested Master intent.
expected_evidence: Target identity, source specification and supported-bit ownership
Raw pre-read byte with decoded standard/OEM/reserved positions
Approved current-to-target transition and exact payload
Raw post-read byte proving only approved changes
Preserved logs and verified restore/recovery audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria are both TBD rather than contradictory. The gap is an incomplete Master contract and project readiness issue.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The named standard operation, configuration domain and safe boundary are identifiable. Execution remains unavailable until the project supplies mask, supported-bit semantics, Expected and recovery; these are not invented by the reviewer.

review_improvement: Separates static reviewability from execution readiness, maps the TBD title to a guarded standard read-modify-write contract, and prevents a guessed mask from suppressing SEL or management signaling.
independent_technical_reasoning: A one-byte global-enables register combines multiple controls and potentially implementation-owned bits. Writing a desired named bit as a fresh byte can unintentionally clear every other enable. Therefore the only defensible candidate method begins with an exact read, changes only approved positions, proves the whole byte afterward and tests the selected behavior; the title alone cannot choose which transition is intended.
